changelog: Phase L103.4 — one-shot backfill script scripts/l103-backfill-subscriptions.php. Maps legacy tenants.plan_id → new tariff_code per L103 plan §4.3 (trial→menu_trial, pro/pro_annual→order, enterprise/_annual→kitchen, enterprise_plus→chain, default→menu). One subscription per tenant on placeholder location_id=1; real location rows sync via Database::syncLocationToControlPlane on next saveLocation. Flags: --dry-run (print only), --tenant=ID (single tenant filter). Preserves status / trial_ends_at / current_period_end. Idempotent via INSERT IGNORE + ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE. Marks paid plans with legacy_grandfather=1 so Phase L103.6 worker can apply grandfathering policy. Emits legacy_migrated_to_l103 events for audit. ZERO behaviour change — no application code reads from subscriptions until Phase L103.5/6.
